title: Three-lap simulated compass replay

arrays.activity: Dimensionless saved model rates, 0 to 1; samples x neurons
arrays.camera: Rendered grayscale pixels; samples x 160 x 160
arrays.position: Simulator position in metres; samples x 3
arrays.heading: Actual simulator yaw in radians, not a model prediction

selection: First three complete consecutive laps of one existing development recording; no activity-based frame selection
model_state: Fixed checkpoint, online plasticity off; no training or checkpoint is included
route_control: Separate simulator controller; compass does not steer the route
limits: Model activity, not measurements from a living fly
One scalar per neuron; no within-neuron propagation
Repeated activity does not establish place recognition
Historical development replay; not a benchmark or validation of the latest model
creator: Luca Crupi
